Do not include real credentials, personal data, internal paths, or a private repository. Use synthetic values and the smallest reproducible file layout. ### Version and rule

- Canship version or development revision:

### Minimal reproduction

Include only the required files, relative paths, and command options. Replace identifying names and paths. State whether configuration, a baseline, or ignore comments affect the result.

### Expected and actual result

Explain which finding should appear or disappear and why. Do not paste full reports or raw credentials.
